Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for side-scrolling action game. Create exactly 12 distinct complete full-body drawings of Jean from Genshin Impact on TRUE transparent alpha, regular 4 columns by 3 rows. Reference 1 is Jean's identity (adult blonde ponytail, blue eyes, white fitted knight trousers and white bodice, navy-blue short coat and split cape with gold trim, dark blue gloves and tall boots, a slender silver single-handed longsword with gold guard). Reference 2 is existing game poses only; upgrade to mature refined detailed Japanese fantasy rendering, NOT chibi. All figures face screen RIGHT in a 3/4 side view. Same identity, outfit, sword and physical scale in EVERY cell.
Row 1: FOUR continuous quiet ready idle breathing poses; calm upright stance, right hand keeps sword diagonally forward/down, subtle chest motion and ponytail/cape followthrough.
Rows 2 and 3: EIGHT chronological distinct full running cycle drawings: right foot contact, compress, push, left flight, left contact, compress, push, right flight. Legs alternate unmistakably, ponytail and coat trail with momentum, sword carried low angled forward. Natural planted feet and toe lift.
Canvas aspect 4:3, use 4x3 even cells. Each character including full hair, cloak, sword tip and both feet fits comfortably INSIDE its own cell with at least 20 pixel completely empty transparent gutter on every side. Center each pelvis horizontally, feet share the same baseline within the cell; no clipping or touching adjacent cells. Generous whitespace because these will be cropped programmatically. Detailed crisp production-quality colored line art, readable at 112px character height. No ground, shadows, scenery, grid, letters, labels, motion blur, extra limbs or decorative effects. Exact 12 drawings, no duplicate poses.
